decisions.reason: Exposing AXP2101 PWROK and VBACKUP does not alter the ESP32 local-decoupling configuration or placement limit.
The new signal-only test pads do not change the placement requirements for AXP2101 or MT3608 decoupling capacitors.
Adding two auxiliary-pin test points is compatible with, but does not change, the single-board architecture or functionality-preservation requirement.
The AXP2101 auxiliary-pin exposure does not change the display-backlight circuit, supply options, control, or component population.
The source explicitly defines PWROK and VBACKUP connections as signal traces rather than power paths, so it does not modify the VBUS, +5V, or BAT- high-current routing requirement.
AXP2101 test pads or vias do not affect the ESP32 breakout header pitch.
Although the test points require local placement beside the AXP2101, the source does not change any current connector, enclosure, orientation, accessibility, or antenna-layout constraint.
This candidate concerns the separate power-board AXP2101 topology; the source applies to the integrated board and does not change its VMID/VSYS, net-label, or thermal-pad requirements.
Exposing PWROK and VBACKUP preserves the selected AXP2101 architecture and does not alter charging, rail, or battery-efficiency requirements.
PWROK and VBACKUP test-point access does not change the required current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of the INA device.
The AXP2101 auxiliary-pin change does not affect the I2C JST connector for the ambient-light sensor.
Small test pads or vias are not connector-assembly changes and do not modify the through-hole requirement for connectors.
